WITH project_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        project_id,
        project_type,
        title,

        run_id AS source_run_id,
        c_pull_timestamp_utc AS source_observed_at,

        downloads AS current_downloads,
        follows,

        (
            follows::DOUBLE
            / NULLIF(downloads, 0)
            * 1000.0
        ) AS follows_per_1000_downloads

    FROM silver.modrinth_project_listings

    WHERE project_type = 'mod'
        AND downloads IS NOT NULL
        AND downloads > 0
        AND follows IS NOT NULL
        AND follows >= 0
),

fan_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        *

    FROM project_metrics

    WHERE current_downloads >= 10000
        AND follows >= 25
),

candidate_ranks AS (
    SELECT
        *,

        RANK() OVER (
            ORDER BY follows_per_1000_downloads
        ) AS follow_rate_rank,

        COUNT(*) OVER (
            PARTITION BY follows_per_1000_downloads
        ) AS follow_rate_tie_count,

        RANK() OVER (
            ORDER BY follows
        ) AS follower_count_rank,

        COUNT(*) OVER (
            PARTITION BY follows
        ) AS follower_count_tie_count,

        COUNT(*) OVER () AS candidate_count

    FROM fan_candidates
),

candidate_percentiles AS (
    SELECT
        *,

        (
            follow_rate_rank
            + ((follow_rate_tie_count - 1) / 2.0)
        )
        / candidate_count
            AS follow_rate_percentile,

        (
            follower_count_rank
            + ((follower_count_tie_count - 1) / 2.0)
        )
        / candidate_count
            AS follower_count_percentile

    FROM candidate_ranks
),

candidate_scores AS (
    SELECT
        *,

        100.0
        * (
            2.0
            * follow_rate_percentile
            * follower_count_percentile
        )
        / NULLIF(
            follow_rate_percentile
            + follower_count_percentile,
            0
        ) AS fan_affinity_score

    FROM candidate_percentiles
),

ranked_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        *,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY
                fan_affinity_score DESC,
                follows_per_1000_downloads DESC,
                follows DESC,
                project_id
        ) AS fan_affinity_rank

    FROM candidate_scores
)

SELECT
    p.project_id,
    p.project_type,
    p.title,

    p.source_run_id,
    p.source_observed_at,

    p.current_downloads,
    p.follows,
    p.follows_per_1000_downloads,

    r.follow_rate_percentile,
    r.follower_count_percentile,

    r.fan_affinity_score,
    r.fan_affinity_rank,

    CASE
        WHEN r.project_id IS NOT NULL
            THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
    END AS is_fan_signal_candidate

FROM project_metrics AS p

LEFT JOIN ranked_candidates AS r
    ON p.project_id = r.project_id

WITH run_summary AS (
    SELECT
        run_id,
        MAX(c_pull_timestamp_utc) AS observed_at

    FROM bronze.main.modrinth_project_listings

    WHERE project_type = 'mod'

    GROUP BY
        run_id
),

current_run AS (
    SELECT
        run_id,
        observed_at

    FROM run_summary

    ORDER BY
        observed_at DESC,
        run_id DESC

    LIMIT 1
),

comparison_run AS (
    SELECT
        r.run_id,
        r.observed_at

    FROM run_summary AS r

    CROSS JOIN current_run AS c

    WHERE r.observed_at <= (
        c.observed_at - INTERVAL '24 hours'
    )

    ORDER BY
        r.observed_at DESC,
        r.run_id DESC

    LIMIT 1
),

baseline_run AS (
    SELECT
        r.run_id,
        r.observed_at

    FROM run_summary AS r

    CROSS JOIN comparison_run AS c

    WHERE r.observed_at <= (
        c.observed_at - INTERVAL '7 days'
    )

    ORDER BY
        r.observed_at DESC,
        r.run_id DESC

    LIMIT 1
),

selected_runs AS (
    SELECT
        run_id,
        observed_at,
        'current' AS snapshot

    FROM current_run

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        run_id,
        observed_at,
        'comparison' AS snapshot

    FROM comparison_run

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        run_id,
        observed_at,
        'baseline' AS snapshot

    FROM baseline_run
),

project_snapshots AS (
    SELECT
        s.snapshot,
        s.observed_at,
        p.run_id,
        p.project_id,

        JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(
            p.payload,
            '$.title'
        ) AS title,

        TRY_CAST(
            JSON_EXTRACT_STRING(
                p.payload,
                '$.downloads'
            )
            AS BIGINT
        ) AS total_downloads,

        p.c_pull_timestamp_utc,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY
                s.snapshot,
                p.project_id

            ORDER BY
                p.c_pull_timestamp_utc DESC
        ) AS row_num

    FROM bronze.main.modrinth_project_listings AS p

    INNER JOIN selected_runs AS s
        ON p.run_id = s.run_id

    WHERE p.project_type = 'mod'
),

deduped_snapshots AS (
    SELECT
        snapshot,
        observed_at,
        run_id,
        project_id,
        title,
        total_downloads

    FROM project_snapshots

    WHERE row_num = 1
),

pivoted_snapshots AS (
    SELECT
        project_id,

        MAX(title) FILTER (
            WHERE snapshot = 'current'
        ) AS title,

        MAX(total_downloads) FILTER (
            WHERE snapshot = 'current'
        ) AS current_downloads,

        MAX(total_downloads) FILTER (
            WHERE snapshot = 'comparison'
        ) AS comparison_downloads,

        MAX(total_downloads) FILTER (
            WHERE snapshot = 'baseline'
        ) AS baseline_downloads,

        MAX(observed_at) FILTER (
            WHERE snapshot = 'current'
        ) AS current_observed_at,

        MAX(observed_at) FILTER (
            WHERE snapshot = 'comparison'
        ) AS comparison_observed_at,

        MAX(observed_at) FILTER (
            WHERE snapshot = 'baseline'
        ) AS baseline_observed_at,

        MAX(run_id) FILTER (
            WHERE snapshot = 'current'
        ) AS current_run_id,

        MAX(run_id) FILTER (
            WHERE snapshot = 'comparison'
        ) AS comparison_run_id,

        MAX(run_id) FILTER (
            WHERE snapshot = 'baseline'
        ) AS baseline_run_id

    FROM deduped_snapshots

    GROUP BY
        project_id
),

calculated_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        *,

        current_downloads
            - comparison_downloads
            AS current_downloads_gained,

        comparison_downloads
            - baseline_downloads
            AS baseline_downloads_gained,

        DATE_DIFF(
            'second',
            comparison_observed_at,
            current_observed_at
        ) / 3600.0 AS current_hours,

        DATE_DIFF(
            'second',
            baseline_observed_at,
            comparison_observed_at
        ) / 3600.0 AS baseline_hours

    FROM pivoted_snapshots

    WHERE current_downloads IS NOT NULL
        AND comparison_downloads IS NOT NULL
        AND baseline_downloads IS NOT NULL
),

project_signals AS (
    SELECT
        project_id,
        title,

        current_run_id,
        comparison_run_id,
        baseline_run_id,

        current_observed_at,
        comparison_observed_at,
        baseline_observed_at,

        current_downloads,
        comparison_downloads,
        baseline_downloads,

        current_downloads_gained,
        baseline_downloads_gained,

        current_hours,
        baseline_hours,

        current_downloads_gained
            / NULLIF(
                current_hours,
                0
            ) AS current_velocity,

        baseline_downloads_gained
            / NULLIF(
                baseline_hours,
                0
            ) AS baseline_velocity

    FROM calculated_metrics

    WHERE current_downloads_gained >= 0
        AND baseline_downloads_gained >= 0
),

project_signals_with_ratios AS (
    SELECT
        *,

        current_velocity
            - baseline_velocity
            AS velocity_lift,

        current_velocity
            / NULLIF(
                baseline_velocity,
                0
            ) AS velocity_ratio

    FROM project_signals
),

trend_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        *

    FROM project_signals_with_ratios

    WHERE baseline_velocity > 0
        AND current_downloads_gained >= 1000
        AND velocity_ratio > 1
),

candidate_ranks AS (
    SELECT
        *,

        RANK() OVER (
            ORDER BY velocity_ratio
        ) AS velocity_ratio_rank,

        COUNT(*) OVER (
            PARTITION BY velocity_ratio
        ) AS velocity_ratio_tie_count,

        RANK() OVER (
            ORDER BY current_downloads_gained
        ) AS download_gain_rank,

        COUNT(*) OVER (
            PARTITION BY current_downloads_gained
        ) AS download_gain_tie_count,

        COUNT(*) OVER () AS candidate_count

    FROM trend_candidates
),

candidate_percentiles AS (
    SELECT
        *,

        (
            velocity_ratio_rank
            + ((velocity_ratio_tie_count - 1) / 2.0)
        )
        / candidate_count
            AS velocity_ratio_percentile,

        (
            download_gain_rank
            + ((download_gain_tie_count - 1) / 2.0)
        )
        / candidate_count
            AS download_gain_percentile

    FROM candidate_ranks
),

candidate_scores AS (
    SELECT
        *,

        100.0
        * (
            2.0
            * velocity_ratio_percentile
            * download_gain_percentile
        )
        / NULLIF(
            velocity_ratio_percentile
            + download_gain_percentile,
            0
        ) AS trend_score

    FROM candidate_percentiles
),

ranked_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        *,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY
                trend_score DESC,
                velocity_ratio DESC,
                current_downloads_gained DESC,
                project_id
        ) AS trend_rank

    FROM candidate_scores
)

SELECT
    s.project_id,
    'mod' AS project_type,
    s.title,

    s.current_run_id,
    s.comparison_run_id,
    s.baseline_run_id,

    s.current_observed_at,
    s.comparison_observed_at,
    s.baseline_observed_at,

    s.current_downloads,
    s.comparison_downloads,
    s.baseline_downloads,

    s.current_downloads_gained,
    s.baseline_downloads_gained,

    s.current_hours,
    s.baseline_hours,

    s.current_velocity,
    s.baseline_velocity,
    s.velocity_lift,
    s.velocity_ratio,

    r.velocity_ratio_percentile,
    r.download_gain_percentile,
    r.trend_score,
    r.trend_rank,

    CASE
        WHEN r.project_id IS NOT NULL
            THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
    END AS is_trending_candidate

FROM project_signals_with_ratios AS s

LEFT JOIN ranked_candidates AS r
    ON s.project_id = r.project_id

WITH project_signals AS (
    SELECT
        project_id,
        project_type,
        title,

        current_observed_at,

        current_downloads,
        current_downloads_gained,

        current_velocity,
        baseline_velocity,
        velocity_lift,
        velocity_ratio,

        trend_score,
        trend_rank

    FROM "api_modrinth_com"."main"."modrinth_project_signals"

    WHERE current_velocity IS NOT NULL
),


latest_versions AS (
    SELECT
        project_id,
        project_type,

        version_id AS latest_version_id,
        version_number AS latest_version_number,
        version_type AS latest_version_type,
        date_published AS latest_release_at

    FROM (
        SELECT
            v.project_id,
            v.project_type,

            v.version_id,
            v.version_number,
            v.version_type,
            v.date_published,

            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY
                    v.project_id,
                    v.project_type

                ORDER BY
                    v.date_published DESC,
                    v.version_id DESC
            ) AS row_number

        FROM silver.modrinth_project_versions AS v

        INNER JOIN project_signals AS s
            ON v.project_id = s.project_id
            AND v.project_type = s.project_type

        WHERE v.date_published <=
            s.current_observed_at
    )

    WHERE row_number = 1
),


version_activity AS (
    SELECT
        v.project_id,
        v.project_type,

        COUNT(
            DISTINCT CAST(
                v.date_published AS DATE
            )
        ) FILTER (
            WHERE v.date_published >=
                s.current_observed_at
                - INTERVAL 30 DAY

            AND v.date_published <=
                s.current_observed_at
        ) AS active_release_days_last_30_days,

        COUNT(
            DISTINCT CAST(
                v.date_published AS DATE
            )
        ) FILTER (
            WHERE v.date_published >=
                s.current_observed_at
                - INTERVAL 90 DAY

            AND v.date_published <=
                s.current_observed_at
        ) AS active_release_days_last_90_days

    FROM silver.modrinth_project_versions AS v

    INNER JOIN project_signals AS s
        ON v.project_id = s.project_id
        AND v.project_type = s.project_type

    GROUP BY
        v.project_id,
        v.project_type
),


project_activity AS (
    SELECT
        s.project_id,
        s.project_type,
        s.title,

        s.current_observed_at,

        l.latest_version_id,
        l.latest_version_number,
        l.latest_version_type,
        l.latest_release_at,

        DATE_DIFF(
            'hour',
            l.latest_release_at,
            s.current_observed_at
        ) / 24.0
            AS days_since_latest_release,

        a.active_release_days_last_30_days,
        a.active_release_days_last_90_days,

        s.current_downloads,
        s.current_downloads_gained,

        s.current_velocity,
        s.baseline_velocity,
        s.velocity_lift,
        s.velocity_ratio,

        s.trend_score,
        s.trend_rank

    FROM project_signals AS s

    INNER JOIN latest_versions AS l
        ON s.project_id = l.project_id
        AND s.project_type = l.project_type

    INNER JOIN version_activity AS a
        ON s.project_id = a.project_id
        AND s.project_type = a.project_type
),


activity_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        *

    FROM project_activity

    WHERE days_since_latest_release
            BETWEEN 0 AND 35

        AND current_downloads_gained >=
            1000

        AND current_velocity > 0
),


candidate_ranks AS (
    SELECT
        *,

        RANK() OVER (
            ORDER BY
                days_since_latest_release DESC
        ) AS release_recency_rank,

        COUNT(*) OVER (
            PARTITION BY
                days_since_latest_release
        ) AS release_recency_tie_count,

        RANK() OVER (
            ORDER BY
                current_velocity
        ) AS current_velocity_rank,

        COUNT(*) OVER (
            PARTITION BY
                current_velocity
        ) AS current_velocity_tie_count,

        COUNT(*) OVER ()
            AS candidate_count

    FROM activity_candidates
),


candidate_percentiles AS (
    SELECT
        *,

        (
            release_recency_rank
            + (
                release_recency_tie_count - 1
            ) / 2.0
        )
        / candidate_count
            AS release_recency_percentile,

        (
            current_velocity_rank
            + (
                current_velocity_tie_count - 1
            ) / 2.0
        )
        / candidate_count
            AS current_velocity_percentile

    FROM candidate_ranks
),


candidate_scores AS (
    SELECT
        *,

        100.0
        * (
            2.0
            * release_recency_percentile
            * current_velocity_percentile
        )
        / NULLIF(
            release_recency_percentile
            + current_velocity_percentile,
            0
        ) AS activity_score

    FROM candidate_percentiles
),


ranked_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        *,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY
                activity_score DESC,
                current_velocity DESC,
                latest_release_at DESC,
                project_id
        ) AS activity_rank

    FROM candidate_scores
)


SELECT
    p.project_id,
    p.project_type,
    p.title,

    p.current_observed_at,

    p.latest_version_id,
    p.latest_version_number,
    p.latest_version_type,
    p.latest_release_at,

    p.days_since_latest_release,

    p.active_release_days_last_30_days,
    p.active_release_days_last_90_days,

    p.current_downloads,
    p.current_downloads_gained,

    p.current_velocity,
    p.baseline_velocity,
    p.velocity_lift,
    p.velocity_ratio,

    p.trend_score,
    p.trend_rank,

    r.release_recency_percentile,
    r.current_velocity_percentile,

    r.activity_score,
    r.activity_rank,

    CASE
        WHEN r.project_id IS NOT NULL
            THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
    END AS is_activity_candidate

FROM project_activity AS p

LEFT JOIN ranked_candidates AS r
    ON p.project_id = r.project_id
    AND p.project_type = r.project_type

WITH project_signals AS (
    SELECT
        project_id,
        project_type,
        title,

        current_observed_at,

        current_downloads,
        comparison_downloads,
        current_downloads_gained,

        current_velocity,
        baseline_velocity,
        velocity_lift,
        velocity_ratio,

        trend_score,
        trend_rank,
        is_trending_candidate,

        (
            current_downloads_gained::DOUBLE
            / NULLIF(
                comparison_downloads,
                0
            )
        ) AS recent_growth_share

    FROM "api_modrinth_com"."main"."modrinth_project_signals"

    WHERE current_downloads IS NOT NULL
        AND current_downloads > 0
),


breakout_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        *

    FROM project_signals

    WHERE is_trending_candidate = TRUE
        AND trend_score IS NOT NULL
        AND current_downloads_gained > 0
),


candidate_ranks AS (
    SELECT
        *,

        RANK() OVER (
            ORDER BY
                trend_score
        ) AS trend_strength_rank,

        COUNT(*) OVER (
            PARTITION BY
                trend_score
        ) AS trend_strength_tie_count,

        RANK() OVER (
            ORDER BY
                current_downloads DESC
        ) AS underexposure_rank,

        COUNT(*) OVER (
            PARTITION BY
                current_downloads
        ) AS underexposure_tie_count,

        COUNT(*) OVER ()
            AS candidate_count

    FROM breakout_candidates
),


candidate_percentiles AS (
    SELECT
        *,

        (
            trend_strength_rank
            + (
                trend_strength_tie_count - 1
            ) / 2.0
        )
        / candidate_count
            AS trend_strength_percentile,

        (
            underexposure_rank
            + (
                underexposure_tie_count - 1
            ) / 2.0
        )
        / candidate_count
            AS underexposure_percentile

    FROM candidate_ranks
),


candidate_scores AS (
    SELECT
        *,

        100.0
        * (
            2.0
            * trend_strength_percentile
            * underexposure_percentile
        )
        / NULLIF(
            trend_strength_percentile
            + underexposure_percentile,
            0
        ) AS breakout_score

    FROM candidate_percentiles
),


ranked_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        *,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY
                breakout_score DESC,
                trend_score DESC,
                underexposure_percentile DESC,
                current_downloads_gained DESC,
                project_id
        ) AS breakout_rank

    FROM candidate_scores
)


SELECT
    p.project_id,
    p.project_type,
    p.title,

    p.current_observed_at,

    p.current_downloads,
    p.comparison_downloads,
    p.current_downloads_gained,
    p.recent_growth_share,

    p.current_velocity,
    p.baseline_velocity,
    p.velocity_lift,
    p.velocity_ratio,

    p.trend_score,
    p.trend_rank,

    r.trend_strength_percentile,
    r.underexposure_percentile,

    r.breakout_score,
    r.breakout_rank,

    CASE
        WHEN r.project_id IS NOT NULL
            THEN TRUE
        ELSE FALSE
    END AS is_breakout_candidate

FROM project_signals AS p

LEFT JOIN ranked_candidates AS r
    ON p.project_id = r.project_id
    AND p.project_type = r.project_type

WITH platform_loaders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        loader_value AS platform_loader

    FROM silver.modrinth_project_versions AS v

    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(
        v.loaders
    ) AS loader_table(loader_value)

    WHERE loader_value IS NOT NULL
),


unnested_categories AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        p.project_id,
        p.project_type,
        category_value AS category

    FROM silver.modrinth_project_listings AS p

    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(
        p.categories
    ) AS category_table(category_value)

    WHERE category_value IS NOT NULL
        AND TRIM(category_value) <> ''
),


gameplay_categories AS (
    SELECT
        c.project_id,
        c.project_type,
        c.category AS gameplay_category

    FROM unnested_categories AS c

    LEFT JOIN platform_loaders AS l
        ON LOWER(c.category)
            = LOWER(l.platform_loader)

    WHERE l.platform_loader IS NULL
),


project_signals AS (
    SELECT
        c.project_id,
        c.project_type,
        c.gameplay_category,

        s.current_observed_at,

        s.current_downloads,
        s.current_downloads_gained,

        s.current_velocity,
        s.baseline_velocity,
        s.velocity_ratio,

        s.trend_score,
        s.trend_rank,

        b.breakout_score,
        b.breakout_rank,
        b.recent_growth_share,

        f.fan_affinity_score,
        f.fan_affinity_rank,

        a.activity_score,
        a.activity_rank,

        CASE
            WHEN s.trend_score IS NOT NULL
                OR b.breakout_score IS NOT NULL
            THEN GREATEST(
                COALESCE(
                    s.trend_score,
                    0
                ),
                COALESCE(
                    b.breakout_score,
                    0
                )
            )

            ELSE NULL
        END AS discovery_score

    FROM gameplay_categories AS c

    LEFT JOIN "api_modrinth_com"."main"."modrinth_project_signals" AS s
        ON c.project_id = s.project_id
        AND c.project_type = s.project_type

    LEFT JOIN "api_modrinth_com"."main"."modrinth_project_breakout_signals" AS b
        ON c.project_id = b.project_id
        AND c.project_type = b.project_type

    LEFT JOIN "api_modrinth_com"."main"."modrinth_project_fan_signals" AS f
        ON c.project_id = f.project_id
        AND c.project_type = f.project_type

    LEFT JOIN "api_modrinth_com"."main"."modrinth_project_activity_signals" AS a
        ON c.project_id = a.project_id
        AND c.project_type = a.project_type
),


project_flags AS (
    SELECT
        *,

        CASE
            WHEN discovery_score IS NOT NULL
            THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS has_discovery_signal,

        CASE
            WHEN discovery_score
                >= 80
            THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS has_strong_discovery_signal,

        CASE
            WHEN breakout_score IS NOT NULL
            THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS has_breakout_signal,

        CASE
            WHEN fan_affinity_score IS NOT NULL
            THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS has_audience_signal,

        CASE
            WHEN fan_affinity_score
                >= 80
            THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS has_strong_audience_signal,

        CASE
            WHEN activity_score IS NOT NULL
            THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS has_activity_signal,

        CASE
            WHEN activity_score
                >= 80
            THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS has_strong_activity_signal,

        CASE
            WHEN discovery_score IS NOT NULL
                OR activity_score IS NOT NULL
            THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS has_content_opportunity,

        CASE
            WHEN discovery_score
                    >= 80
                OR activity_score
                    >= 80
            THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_momentum_project

    FROM project_signals
),


category_aggregates AS (
    SELECT
        project_type,
        gameplay_category,

        MAX(
            current_observed_at
        ) AS current_observed_at,

        COUNT(
            DISTINCT project_id
        ) AS total_projects,

        COUNT(
            DISTINCT project_id
        ) FILTER (
            WHERE has_discovery_signal = TRUE
        ) AS projects_with_discovery_signal,

        COUNT(
            DISTINCT project_id
        ) FILTER (
            WHERE has_strong_discovery_signal = TRUE
        ) AS projects_with_strong_discovery,

        COUNT(
            DISTINCT project_id
        ) FILTER (
            WHERE has_breakout_signal = TRUE
        ) AS projects_with_breakout_signal,

        COUNT(
            DISTINCT project_id
        ) FILTER (
            WHERE has_audience_signal = TRUE
        ) AS projects_with_audience_signal,

        COUNT(
            DISTINCT project_id
        ) FILTER (
            WHERE has_strong_audience_signal = TRUE
        ) AS projects_with_strong_audience,

        COUNT(
            DISTINCT project_id
        ) FILTER (
            WHERE has_activity_signal = TRUE
        ) AS projects_with_activity_signal,

        COUNT(
            DISTINCT project_id
        ) FILTER (
            WHERE has_strong_activity_signal = TRUE
        ) AS projects_with_strong_activity,

        COUNT(
            DISTINCT project_id
        ) FILTER (
            WHERE has_content_opportunity = TRUE
        ) AS projects_with_content_opportunity,

        COUNT(
            DISTINCT project_id
        ) FILTER (
            WHERE is_momentum_project = TRUE
        ) AS momentum_project_count,

        SUM(
            COALESCE(
                current_downloads_gained,
                0
            )
        ) AS total_downloads_gained,

        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN is_momentum_project = TRUE
                THEN COALESCE(
                    current_downloads_gained,
                    0
                )

                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS momentum_downloads_gained,

        AVG(
            COALESCE(
                current_downloads_gained,
                0
            )
        ) AS average_downloads_gained,

        AVG(
            current_downloads_gained
        ) FILTER (
            WHERE is_momentum_project = TRUE
        ) AS average_momentum_downloads_gained,

        MEDIAN(
            velocity_ratio
        ) FILTER (
            WHERE velocity_ratio IS NOT NULL
        ) AS median_velocity_ratio

    FROM project_flags

    GROUP BY
        project_type,
        gameplay_category
),


eligible_categories AS (
    SELECT
        *,

        CAST(
            momentum_project_count
            AS DOUBLE
        )
        /
        NULLIF(
            total_projects,
            0
        ) AS momentum_project_share,

        CAST(
            momentum_downloads_gained
            AS DOUBLE
        )
        /
        NULLIF(
            total_downloads_gained,
            0
        ) AS momentum_download_gain_share,

        CASE
            WHEN momentum_project_count
                >= 3
            THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_category_momentum_candidate

    FROM category_aggregates

    WHERE total_projects
        >= 10
),


percentile_rank_inputs AS (
    SELECT
        *,

        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY project_type

            ORDER BY
                momentum_project_count ASC
        ) AS momentum_count_rank,

        COUNT(*) OVER (
            PARTITION BY
                project_type,
                momentum_project_count
        ) AS momentum_count_tie_count,


        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY project_type

            ORDER BY
                momentum_project_share ASC
        ) AS momentum_share_rank,

        COUNT(*) OVER (
            PARTITION BY
                project_type,
                momentum_project_share
        ) AS momentum_share_tie_count,


        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY project_type

            ORDER BY
                momentum_download_gain_share ASC
        ) AS momentum_download_gain_share_rank,

        COUNT(*) OVER (
            PARTITION BY
                project_type,
                momentum_download_gain_share
        ) AS momentum_download_gain_share_tie_count,


        COUNT(*) OVER (
            PARTITION BY project_type
        ) AS category_count

    FROM eligible_categories
),


percentiles AS (
    SELECT
        *,

        (
            momentum_count_rank
            +
            (
                momentum_count_tie_count
                - 1
            )
            / 2.0
        )
        /
        category_count
        AS momentum_count_percentile,


        (
            momentum_share_rank
            +
            (
                momentum_share_tie_count
                - 1
            )
            / 2.0
        )
        /
        category_count
        AS momentum_share_percentile,


        (
            momentum_download_gain_share_rank
            +
            (
                momentum_download_gain_share_tie_count
                - 1
            )
            / 2.0
        )
        /
        category_count
        AS momentum_download_gain_share_percentile

    FROM percentile_rank_inputs
),


scored_categories AS (
    SELECT
        *,

        CASE
            WHEN is_category_momentum_candidate = TRUE
            THEN
                100.0
                *
                (
                    3.0
                    * momentum_count_percentile
                    * momentum_share_percentile
                    * momentum_download_gain_share_percentile
                )
                /
                NULLIF(
                    (
                        momentum_count_percentile
                        * momentum_share_percentile
                    )
                    +
                    (
                        momentum_count_percentile
                        * momentum_download_gain_share_percentile
                    )
                    +
                    (
                        momentum_share_percentile
                        * momentum_download_gain_share_percentile
                    ),
                    0
                )

            ELSE NULL
        END AS category_momentum_score

    FROM percentiles
),


ranked_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        project_type,
        gameplay_category,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY project_type

            ORDER BY
                category_momentum_score DESC,
                momentum_project_count DESC,
                momentum_project_share DESC,
                momentum_download_gain_share DESC,
                gameplay_category
        ) AS category_momentum_rank

    FROM scored_categories

    WHERE is_category_momentum_candidate = TRUE
)


SELECT
    s.project_type,
    s.gameplay_category,

    s.current_observed_at,

    s.total_projects,

    s.projects_with_discovery_signal,
    s.projects_with_strong_discovery,

    s.projects_with_breakout_signal,

    s.projects_with_audience_signal,
    s.projects_with_strong_audience,

    s.projects_with_activity_signal,
    s.projects_with_strong_activity,

    s.projects_with_content_opportunity,

    s.momentum_project_count,
    s.momentum_project_share,

    s.total_downloads_gained,
    s.momentum_downloads_gained,
    s.momentum_download_gain_share,

    s.average_downloads_gained,
    s.average_momentum_downloads_gained,

    s.median_velocity_ratio,

    s.momentum_count_percentile,
    s.momentum_share_percentile,
    s.momentum_download_gain_share_percentile,

    s.category_momentum_score,
    r.category_momentum_rank,

    s.is_category_momentum_candidate

FROM scored_categories AS s

LEFT JOIN ranked_candidates AS r
    ON s.project_type = r.project_type
    AND s.gameplay_category = r.gameplay_category

WITH combined_signals AS (
    SELECT
        s.project_id,
        s.project_type,
        s.title,

        s.current_observed_at,

        s.current_downloads,
        s.current_downloads_gained,

        s.current_velocity,
        s.baseline_velocity,
        s.velocity_ratio,

        s.trend_score,
        s.trend_rank,
        s.is_trending_candidate,

        b.breakout_score,
        b.breakout_rank,
        b.recent_growth_share,
        b.is_breakout_candidate,

        f.fan_affinity_score,
        f.fan_affinity_rank,
        f.follows,
        f.follows_per_1000_downloads,
        f.is_fan_signal_candidate,

        a.activity_score,
        a.activity_rank,

        a.latest_version_number,
        a.latest_version_type,
        a.latest_release_at,
        a.days_since_latest_release,

        a.active_release_days_last_30_days,
        a.active_release_days_last_90_days,

        a.is_activity_candidate

    FROM "api_modrinth_com"."main"."modrinth_project_signals" AS s

    LEFT JOIN "api_modrinth_com"."main"."modrinth_project_breakout_signals" AS b
        ON s.project_id = b.project_id
        AND s.project_type = b.project_type

    LEFT JOIN "api_modrinth_com"."main"."modrinth_project_fan_signals" AS f
        ON s.project_id = f.project_id
        AND s.project_type = f.project_type

    LEFT JOIN "api_modrinth_com"."main"."modrinth_project_activity_signals" AS a
        ON s.project_id = a.project_id
        AND s.project_type = a.project_type
),


signal_families AS (
    SELECT
        *,

        CASE
            WHEN trend_score IS NOT NULL
                OR breakout_score IS NOT NULL
            THEN GREATEST(
                COALESCE(
                    trend_score,
                    0
                ),
                COALESCE(
                    breakout_score,
                    0
                )
            )

            ELSE NULL
        END AS discovery_score,

        fan_affinity_score
            AS audience_score,

        activity_score
            AS development_activity_score

    FROM combined_signals
),


signal_flags AS (
    SELECT
        *,

        CASE
            WHEN discovery_score IS NOT NULL
                THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS has_discovery_signal,

        CASE
            WHEN audience_score IS NOT NULL
                THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS has_audience_signal,

        CASE
            WHEN development_activity_score IS NOT NULL
                THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS has_activity_signal,

        CASE
            WHEN discovery_score >=
                80
                THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS has_strong_discovery_signal,

        CASE
            WHEN audience_score >=
                80
                THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS has_strong_audience_signal,

        CASE
            WHEN development_activity_score >=
                80
                THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS has_strong_activity_signal

    FROM signal_families
),


signal_counts AS (
    SELECT
        *,

        CAST(
            has_strong_discovery_signal
            AS INTEGER
        )
        +
        CAST(
            has_strong_audience_signal
            AS INTEGER
        )
        +
        CAST(
            has_strong_activity_signal
            AS INTEGER
        ) AS cross_signal_count

    FROM signal_flags
),


content_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        *,

        GREATEST(
            COALESCE(
                discovery_score,
                0
            ),
            COALESCE(
                development_activity_score,
                0
            )
        ) AS primary_signal_score

    FROM signal_counts

    WHERE has_discovery_signal = TRUE
        OR has_activity_signal = TRUE
),


support_units AS (
    SELECT
        *,

        LEAST(
            1.0,
            GREATEST(
                COALESCE(
                    discovery_score,
                    0
                )
                - 50,
                0
            )
            / NULLIF(
                100.0
                - 50,
                0
            )
        ) AS discovery_support_unit,

        LEAST(
            1.0,
            GREATEST(
                COALESCE(
                    audience_score,
                    0
                )
                - 50,
                0
            )
            / NULLIF(
                100.0
                - 50,
                0
            )
        ) AS audience_support_unit,

        LEAST(
            1.0,
            GREATEST(
                COALESCE(
                    development_activity_score,
                    0
                )
                - 50,
                0
            )
            / NULLIF(
                100.0
                - 50,
                0
            )
        ) AS activity_support_unit,

        LEAST(
            1.0,
            GREATEST(
                primary_signal_score
                - 50,
                0
            )
            / NULLIF(
                100.0
                - 50,
                0
            )
        ) AS primary_support_unit

    FROM content_candidates
),


support_scores AS (
    SELECT
        *,

        (
            discovery_support_unit
            + audience_support_unit
            + activity_support_unit
            - primary_support_unit
        )
        / 2.0 AS support_strength

    FROM support_units
),


content_scores AS (
    SELECT
        *,

        LEAST(
            100.0,

            primary_signal_score
            +
            (
                100.0
                - primary_signal_score
            )
            * 0.5
            * support_strength
        ) AS content_opportunity_score

    FROM support_scores
),


ranked_content AS (
    SELECT
        *,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY
                content_opportunity_score DESC,
                cross_signal_count DESC,
                primary_signal_score DESC,
                current_downloads_gained DESC,
                project_id
        ) AS content_opportunity_rank

    FROM content_scores
)


SELECT
    project_id,
    project_type,
    title,

    current_observed_at,

    current_downloads,
    current_downloads_gained,

    current_velocity,
    baseline_velocity,
    velocity_ratio,

    trend_score,

    breakout_score,

    recent_growth_share,

    fan_affinity_score,

    activity_score,
    activity_rank,

    latest_version_number,
    latest_version_type,
    latest_release_at,
    days_since_latest_release,

    active_release_days_last_30_days,
    active_release_days_last_90_days,

FROM ranked_content

WITH content_signals AS (
    SELECT
        c.*

    FROM "api_modrinth_com"."main"."modrinth_project_content_signals" AS c
),


category_matches AS (
    SELECT
        c.project_id,
        c.project_type,

        m.gameplay_category,

        m.category_momentum_score,
        m.category_momentum_rank,

        m.total_projects
            AS category_total_projects,

        m.momentum_project_count
            AS category_momentum_project_count,

        m.momentum_project_share
            AS category_momentum_project_share,

        m.momentum_downloads_gained
            AS category_momentum_downloads_gained,

        m.momentum_download_gain_share
            AS category_momentum_download_gain_share,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY
                c.project_id,
                c.project_type

            ORDER BY
                m.category_momentum_score DESC NULLS LAST,
                m.category_momentum_rank ASC NULLS LAST,
                m.gameplay_category
        ) AS category_row_num

    FROM content_signals AS c

    INNER JOIN silver.modrinth_project_listings AS p
        ON c.project_id = p.project_id
        AND c.project_type = p.project_type

    INNER JOIN "api_modrinth_com"."main"."modrinth_category_momentum_signals" AS m
        ON c.project_type = m.project_type

        AND list_contains(
            p.categories,
            m.gameplay_category
        )

    WHERE m.is_category_momentum_candidate = TRUE
),


category_context AS (
    SELECT
        project_id,
        project_type,

        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN category_row_num = 1
                THEN gameplay_category
            END
        ) AS strongest_momentum_category,

        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN category_row_num = 1
                THEN category_momentum_score
            END
        ) AS strongest_category_momentum_score,

        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN category_row_num = 1
                THEN category_momentum_rank
            END
        ) AS strongest_category_momentum_rank,

        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN category_row_num = 1
                THEN category_total_projects
            END
        ) AS strongest_category_total_projects,

        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN category_row_num = 1
                THEN category_momentum_project_count
            END
        ) AS strongest_category_momentum_project_count,

        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN category_row_num = 1
                THEN category_momentum_project_share
            END
        ) AS strongest_category_momentum_project_share,

        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN category_row_num = 1
                THEN category_momentum_downloads_gained
            END
        ) AS strongest_category_momentum_downloads_gained,

        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN category_row_num = 1
                THEN category_momentum_download_gain_share
            END
        ) AS strongest_category_momentum_download_gain_share,

        COUNT(
            DISTINCT gameplay_category
        ) FILTER (
            WHERE category_momentum_score
                >= 60
        ) AS high_momentum_category_count

    FROM category_matches

    GROUP BY
        project_id,
        project_type
),


story_inputs AS (
    SELECT
        c.*,

        ctx.strongest_momentum_category,
        ctx.strongest_category_momentum_score,
        ctx.strongest_category_momentum_rank,

        ctx.strongest_category_total_projects,
        ctx.strongest_category_momentum_project_count,
        ctx.strongest_category_momentum_project_share,

        ctx.strongest_category_momentum_downloads_gained,
        ctx.strongest_category_momentum_download_gain_share,

        COALESCE(
            ctx.high_momentum_category_count,
            0
        ) AS high_momentum_category_count

    FROM content_signals AS c

    LEFT JOIN category_context AS ctx
        ON c.project_id = ctx.project_id
        AND c.project_type = ctx.project_type
),


story_flags AS (
    SELECT
        *,

        CASE
            WHEN cross_signal_count >= 2
            THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_multi_signal_story,


        CASE
            WHEN breakout_score
                >= 90
            THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_breakout_story,


        CASE
            WHEN discovery_score
                    >= 80

                AND development_activity_score
                    >= 80

            THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_fresh_update_momentum_story,


        CASE
            WHEN trend_score
                    >= 90

                AND current_downloads
                    >= 1000000

            THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_established_heating_up_story,


        CASE
            WHEN audience_score
                    >= 90

                AND (
                    discovery_score
                        >= 80

                    OR development_activity_score
                        >= 80
                )

            THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_cult_favorite_story,


        CASE
            WHEN development_activity_score >= 90
            THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_fresh_release_attention_story,


        CASE
            WHEN discovery_score >= 90
            THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS is_discovery_spike_story,


        CASE
            WHEN strongest_category_momentum_score
                >= 60

            THEN TRUE
            ELSE FALSE
        END AS has_strong_ecosystem_context

    FROM story_inputs
),


story_classification AS (
    SELECT
        *,

        CASE
            WHEN is_breakout_story = TRUE
            THEN 'Breakout Gem'

            WHEN is_fresh_update_momentum_story = TRUE
            THEN 'Fresh Update + Momentum'

            WHEN is_established_heating_up_story = TRUE
            THEN 'Established Mod Heating Up'

            WHEN is_cult_favorite_story = TRUE
            THEN 'Cult Favorite in Motion'

            WHEN is_fresh_release_attention_story = TRUE
            THEN 'Fresh Release Getting Attention'

            WHEN is_discovery_spike_story = TRUE
            THEN 'Discovery Spike'

            ELSE 'General Opportunity'
        END AS primary_story_type,


        CASE
            WHEN is_breakout_story = TRUE
            THEN
                'Underexposed project showing unusually strong current discovery momentum.'

            WHEN is_fresh_update_momentum_story = TRUE
            THEN
                'Project has both strong discovery momentum and strong recent release activity.'

            WHEN is_established_heating_up_story = TRUE
            THEN
                'Established project is showing unusually strong current trend momentum.'

            WHEN is_cult_favorite_story = TRUE
            THEN
                'Project has unusually strong fan affinity alongside a strong current discovery or activity signal.'

            WHEN is_fresh_release_attention_story = TRUE
            THEN
                'Project has a recent release receiving unusually strong current attention.'

            WHEN is_discovery_spike_story = TRUE
            THEN
                'Project is showing unusually strong current discovery momentum.'

            ELSE
                'Project qualifies as a current content opportunity based on discovery or activity signals.'
        END AS story_reason

    FROM story_flags
)


SELECT

        AS story_priority_rank,
